verdict.rationale: Datadog documents managed evaluations that can be enabled and are attached to individual traced spans from instrumented LLM applications, with checks such as language mismatch and sensitive-data detection. This is separate from its dataset-based Experiments feature, which strongly implies evaluation of live traffic. However, the docs shown never explicitly say evaluators run continuously on production traffic. missing for 10: explicit documentation that managed evaluators run continuously on live production spans, sampling/filtering controls for production traffic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Agent Observability associates evaluations with individual spans so you can view the inputs and outputs that led to a specific evaluation.
Alternatively, you can Save as Draft and edit or enable it later.
Flags the presence of sensitive or regulated information in model inputs or outputs
The Agent Observability SDK provides the methods `LLMObs.submit_evaluation()` and `LLMObs.export_span()` to help your traced LLM application submit external evaluations to Agent Observability.
